claim: Apache Arrow specifies a language-agnostic columnar representation and transport protocol, demonstrating that portable data contracts must not be owned by one Python implementation.
The executable package analyzes software repositories through structural, temporal, semantic and relationship models.
OpenTelemetry distinguishes traces, metrics, logs and baggage as telemetry signals, so code-intelligence observations must not collapse those signal kinds into domain events or business facts.
The application-behavior universe owns provider-neutral commands, queries, state transitions, coordination, effects and execution-evidence contracts while imported universes retain their meanings.
pyproject.toml declares Python build-system, project metadata, dependencies, scripts and tool configuration.

Substrait specifies cross-language relational plan types, expressions, relations, serialization and extensions, demonstrating that a Python planner is one producer or consumer rather than plan authority by default.
